4.0.6.boundary: This patch-line release postdates v4.1 chronologically but remains a minor-zero input in the FSE candidate frame.

version_metadata_path.generation: During process-sources, hazelcast/pom.xml runs maven-resources-plugin copy-resources with filtering=true from src/main/template to src/main/java.
version_metadata_path.provider_behavior: BuildInfoProvider reads GeneratedBuildProperties.VERSION by reflection and passes it unchanged into BuildInfo.
version_metadata_path.client_behavior: BuildInfoUtils.getMinorVersion() obtains BuildInfo.getVersion(), parses the dotted version, and returns token 1.
version_metadata_path.conclusion: The observed 0-to-1 result is caused by Maven project-version metadata entering an unchanged generated-property and provider path, not by a new 4.1 runtime parsing algorithm.

isolated_mechanism.subject: 4.1-SNAPSHOT
isolated_mechanism.change: The root and hazelcast module POM versions change from 4.0-SNAPSHOT to 4.1-SNAPSHOT, which changes the value filtered into GeneratedBuildProperties.VERSION.
isolated_mechanism.release_change: The same POM versions change from 4.1-SNAPSHOT to 4.1.
isolated_mechanism.patch_boundary: source-mechanism.patch contains only the two actual maintainer POM hunks from the development-line commit; it is source-side evidence, not a target repair.
